prompt: What should she do if she wants the handle fixed?
promptZh: 如果她想修好杯把，應該怎麼做？

options.text: Take the mug home and return next week without leaving any details.
options.zh: 把杯子帶回家，下週再來，不留聯絡資料。
options.whyZh: 她問能否下週再拿來，但男方要求今天留在維修架並寫電話，未說她打算不留聯絡資料。

options.text: Put the mug back on the general pickup shelf.
options.zh: 把杯子放回一般領取架。
options.whyZh: 男方指定維修架，不是領取架。

options.text: Leave both blue mugs so the studio can pick one to repair.
options.zh: 兩個藍杯都留下，請工作室選一個修。
options.whyZh: 她已確認自己的杯子，不須交出另一人的杯子。

options.text: Leave her mug on the repair shelf with a new contact tag.
options.zh: 把她的杯子留在維修架，附上寫有聯絡資料的新標籤。
options.whyZh: 男方要求今天留下她的杯子，附新紙標並寫電話。

explanationZh: 男方要求今天留下她的杯子，附新紙標並寫電話。
evidence: One has my little triangle, but its handle feels rough. Can I take it home and bring it back next week? / If you want us to smooth the handle, leave it on the repair shelf today. Write your phone number on a new paper tag, so we can contact you when it’s ready.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: One has my little triangle, but its handle feels rough. Can I take it home and bring it back next week?

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: If you want us to smooth the handle, leave it on the repair shelf today. Write your phone number on a new paper tag, so we can contact you when it’s ready.

vocabulary.note: 在此用來留下聯絡電話，不是燒製前的識別紙標。
